lessons.title: Ranking of Levels and all Important Levels
lessons.description: Trick discusses the importance and ranking of different levels in trading. He explains the significance of intraday levels, daily chart levels, gaps, range highs and lows, and moving averages. He provides examples and emphasize the role of volume in determining the strength of levels. Trick also discusses the relevance of trend lines in trading. Overall, the video aims to provide insights into the ranking and significance of various levels in trading strategies.
